name: Tone Matrix
description: Tap squares on a 16×16 grid and it plays a looping melody that always sounds good, with ripples of light. Share it as a link.
prompt: A 16 by 16 step sequencer on a pentatonic scale: tap or drag to fill squares, it loops with glowing ripples, three sounds, tempo, random and clear buttons, and the pattern can be shared as a link.
author: gonzaroman
